title: Dialogues
subtitle: A2 · Unit 11: Solve a practical problem politely

steps.title: Dialogues
steps.body: Track the three parts of each exchange: problem, specific request, next step. Notice when a short imperative belongs to an instruction and when a conditional is used to ask for another person's help.

steps.title: Ask about a missing delivery
steps.body: Karim contacts a fictional delivery service about a parcel.

examples.fr: Bonjour, je n'ai pas reçu le colis. Voici le numéro de suivi.
examples.en: Karim: Hello, I have not received the parcel. Here is the tracking number.
Employée: Could you confirm the delivery address?

examples.fr: Oui. Pourriez-vous aussi vérifier le créneau de livraison ?
examples.en: Karim: Yes. Could you also check the delivery time slot?

examples.fr: Je vérifie. Il y a eu une tentative de livraison hier.
examples.en: Employée: I am checking. There was a delivery attempt yesterday.

examples.fr: Je voudrais une nouvelle livraison, s'il vous plaît.
examples.en: Karim: I would like a new delivery, please.

examples.fr: D'accord. Appuyez sur le bouton de confirmation dans le message.
examples.en: Employée: All right. Press the confirmation button in the message.

examples.fr: Je confirme le délai de traitement : deux jours ?
examples.en: Karim: I am confirming the processing time: two days?

examples.fr: Oui. La confirmation arrive par message.
examples.en: Employée: Yes. The confirmation arrives by text.

steps.title: Request a repair appointment
steps.body: Nadia sends a fictional repair request to the property contact.

examples.fr: Bonjour. Il y a une fuite d'eau sous le robinet.
examples.en: Nadia: Hello. There is a water leak under the tap.

examples.fr: Pourriez-vous envoyer une photo et préciser le problème ?
examples.en: Contact: Could you send a photo and specify the problem?

examples.fr: Oui. Je voudrais un rendez-vous d'entretien cette semaine.
examples.en: Nadia: Yes. I would like a maintenance appointment this week.

examples.fr: Attachez la photo à votre demande, s'il vous plaît.
examples.en: Contact: Please attach the photo to your request.

examples.fr: Je l'attache maintenant. Quel est le délai de traitement ?
examples.en: Nadia: I am attaching it now. What is the processing time?
Contact: I can confirm the time tomorrow.
Nadia: Could you send me a written reply?

examples.fr: Oui, je vous envoie la confirmation demain.
examples.en: Contact: Yes, I will send you the confirmation tomorrow.

steps.prompt: What information does the delivery employee ask Karim to confirm?
steps.explain: The employee asks him to confirm the delivery address.

steps.prompt: What does Karim request from the delivery service?
steps.explain: He says he would like a new delivery.

steps.prompt: What does the contact ask Nadia to attach?
steps.explain: The contact asks her to attach a photo to the request.

steps.prompt: What does Nadia request after attaching the photo?
steps.explain: She asks for a written reply.
